chunks: It is not permissible for a man to perform salat (prayer) while there is a sword before him, because the qiblah is security.
That was narrated from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام
key_terms.أَمْنٌ: security, safety, and freedom from threat
key_terms.سَيْفٌ: a sword placed before the worshipper
key_terms.لَا يَجُوزُ: it is not permissible; indicates a legal prohibition

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray while a sword is placed in front of the worshipper?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the etiquette and state of salat (prayer), forbidding prayer while a sword is directly before the worshipper. It explains this by describing the qiblah as a place of security, indicating that prayer should be performed in a condition of calm and safety.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.759 - "It is not permissible for a man to pray while there is a sword in front of him, because the Qibla is a place of security."
This was narrated from The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as).
